title: Shell Station Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Shell Station is a 3 BR / 2 BA / 6 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Painted in refreshing ocean hues, ‘Shell Station’ presents a relaxing beach getaway, with a traditionally constructed cottage that’s comfortably close to everything in Seaside.
description_expanded: Description63 Pensacola Street1 KING, 1 QUEEN, 1 BUNKROOM WITH 4 TWINSPrime Location in the Heart of Seaside, FloridaNestled in the heart of Seaside, Florida, Shell Station is a cherished family favorite offering an unbeatable location just steps from everything that defines this iconic beach town. Situated only 325 feet from the nearest beach access, just a three-minute walk to Seaside’s shops and restaurants, and one block from the community pool, this home places the very best of Seaside at your doorstep—from morning beach walks to sunset cocktails in town.Light-Filled Living with Coastal CharacterStep inside and be welcomed by natural light pouring through a rose-hued cupola, illuminating the home’s dramatic three-story living and dining space. Inspired by Gulf Coast sunsets, the interiors feature soft coastal tones, whimsical artwork, and warm architectural details. A cozy fireplace framed by curated books anchors the living area, while a spacious sectional and large flat-screen TV create the perfect setting for relaxed family movie nights. Thoughtful reading nooks throughout the home offer peaceful corners to unwind.Indoor–Outdoor Living, Seaside StyleEnjoy mornings with coffee on the screened-in front porch or wind down in the evening with a glass of wine as the neighborhood lights glow. Just off the main living space, the fully equipped kitchen is ideal for preparing meals together, whether you’re cooking a casual breakfast or a gourmet dinner. The wood-burning fireplace adds a charming touch during cooler coastal evenings.Comfortable Bedrooms for Families & FriendsOn the first floor, a queen guest bedroom with a newly remodeled en-suite bathroom provides privacy and comfort. Upstairs, the primary suite features a custom king bed with ample storage and French doors opening to a furnished screened porch. Complete with club chairs and a dreamy bed swing, this space is perfect for afternoon naps, reading, or listening to the nearby Gulf breeze. Also on this level, a second guest bedroom is ideal for kids or extra guests, offering two custom-built bunk beds and playful décor overlooking the great room from an indoor balcony. Both upstairs bedrooms share a beautifully remodeled full bath with a walk-in shower.Backyard Entertaining & Easy Beach AccessThe back porch completes the Shell Station experience with custom-built seating, a central outdoor dining table accented by string lights, and convenient beach amenities including a charcoal grill and outdoor shower. Located on quiet Pensacola Street, the home offers quick access through the Pensacola Pavilion to Seaside’s sugar-white sands and emerald Gulf waters—just a short stroll away.A Timeless Seaside RetreatWith newly renovated bathrooms, updated wood floors, and a brand-new washer and dryer, Shell Station blends classic Seaside charm with modern comfort. Thoughtfully designed, light-filled, and perfectly located, this coastal home is an inviting retreat for families and friends looking to experience the magic of Seaside, Florida. * 5NT minimum Spring Break & Summer; 3NT minimum Fall; 2NT minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES1,267 square feet1-minute walk (318 feet) to beach accessSeaside Private Residential Beach at Pensacola Pavilion — the largest private residential beach on 30AWood-burning fireplaceKeurig coffee makerOutdoor showerCharcoal grillWasher & dryerPeacock Alley Linens — fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR23-002038
